abort.callsign_in_use: Another APRS entry already logs in with this callsign and SSID. Use a different SSID.

error.comment_too_long: Shorten the comment to 43 characters, or 36 for a weather station or a moving location.
error.invalid_auth: The passcode is not valid for this callsign.
error.invalid_callsign: Enter a callsign, optionally with an SSID, such as N0CALL-13.
error.invalid_callsigns: Enter one or more callsigns to track, such as N0CALL-9, or N0CALL* for every SSID.
error.invalid_comment: Use only printable ASCII characters other than | and ~. Don't start the comment with something like 123/456, which reads as course and speed, or for a weather station with a letter and digit such as h50, which reads as weather data.
error.invalid_symbol: Enter a symbol table character (/, \ or an overlay letter or digit) followed by the symbol code, such as /_ for a weather station.
error.weather_interval_too_short: Weather networks ask for no more than one report every 5 minutes.
error.weather_symbol_required: Weather data can only be sent with a weather station symbol, such as /_.

data_description.password: APRS-IS passcode for the callsign. Receivers can leave it empty to log in receive-only.

data_description.callsign: Callsign to log in to APRS-IS with.
data_description.callsigns: Stations to track. End a callsign with * to track every SSID. Weather stations are not tracked.
data_description.password: APRS-IS passcode for the callsign. Optional; leave empty to log in receive-only.
APRS-IS passcode for the callsign. Receivers can enter -1 to log in receive-only. Leave it empty to keep the current one.

reconfigure.description: Change the server or passcode {callsign} logs in with.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure {callsign}

data_description.comment: Text sent at the end of each report: up to 43 characters, or 36 for a weather station or a moving location. It is shortened to make room for altitude, when sent.
data_description.location_entity: Zone, person or device tracker whose position is reported.
data_description.motion_entity: Optional device tracker whose reported speed, course and altitude are sent, such as a phone's when the location is a person. Defaults to the location. Speed, course and altitude are only sent when the device reports them.
data_description.position_ambiguity: Number of trailing position digits to leave out, from 0 (exact) to 4 (nearest degree).
data_description.report_interval: Minutes between reports, or the longest gap with SmartBeaconing. Defaults to 10 with weather data (at least 5) and 30 without.
data_description.smart_beaconing: For a person or device tracker, report more often the faster it moves (every 3 to 5 minutes at speed, walking or driving), soon after turning or stopping, and at the report interval when stopped. Turned off, it reports at the report interval.
data_description.suppress_template: Optional template; while it renders true, no reports are sent, for example near home. A report goes out as soon as it renders false again. If it fails to render, reports are held back too.
data_description.symbol: APRS symbol table and code, such as /_ for a weather station or /- for a house.

data_description.pressure: Barometric pressure sensor, corrected to sea level.
data_description.rain_1h: Sensor for the rain that fell in the last hour.
data_description.rain_24h: Sensor for the rain that fell in the last 24 hours.
data_description.rain_since_midnight: Sensor for the rain that fell since midnight.
data_description.wind_direction: Sensor for the direction the wind blows from, in degrees.

weather.description: Sensors to report. Values are converted to APRS units; unavailable sensors are left out.
weather.name: Weather

data_description.callsign: Callsign and SSID the station reports as, such as N0CALL-13.
data_description.host: APRS-IS server to send reports to.

user.description: Publish your own position and weather to APRS-IS, or track other stations' positions.

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to APRS-IS server {host}.

yaml_import_cannot_connect.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because Home Assistant could not connect to the APRS-IS server {host}.

Check that the server is reachable, then restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the APRS `device_tracker` configuration from your configuration.yaml file and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_cannot_connect.title: The APRS YAML configuration could not be imported

yaml_import_invalid_auth.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because the APRS-IS server refused its passcode.

Fix or remove the `password` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_auth.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_invalid_callsign.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because its `username` is not a valid callsign. It must be a callsign, optionally with an SSID, such as N0CALL-13.

Fix the `username` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_callsign.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_invalid_callsigns.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed because its `callsigns` are not valid. Each must be a callsign, optionally with an SSID or ending in * for every SSID.

Fix the `callsigns` in the APRS `device_tracker` configuration in your configuration.yaml file and restart Home Assistant, or remove that configuration and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_invalid_callsigns.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]

yaml_import_unknown.description:
Importing the APRS device tracker configuration for {callsign} failed with an unexpected error; check the logs for details.

Restart Home Assistant to try again, or remove the APRS `device_tracker` configuration from your configuration.yaml file and set up the APRS integration in the UI.
yaml_import_unknown.title: [%key:component::aprs::issues::yaml_import_cannot_connect::title%]
